# AgentCI

> AgentCI is an evidence-first reliability, regression-testing, and experimental sandbox-certification project for AI-agent workflows and executable agent targets. It is designed to turn agent behavior and execution-boundary claims into reproducible machine-readable evidence that can be independently falsified in CI.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/jinngimk-lang/agentci

## Active experimental program: Agent Sandbox Certification

AgentCI's primary open research line is provider-neutral **Agent Sandbox Certification**.

Core question:

> A sandbox says an AI agent is contained. How do we prove the effective boundary actually holds?

Current status: **S0 contract convergence / experimental open research**.

Do not claim that AgentCI has certified a sandbox backend or proved a provider secure. No backend is currently certified by AgentCI.

Canonical public program surfaces:

- Program decisions: https://github.com/jinngimk-lang/agentci/issues/24
- Product contract and probes: https://github.com/jinngimk-lang/agentci/issues/25
- Independent red team: https://github.com/jinngimk-lang/agentci/issues/26
- Isolation/runtime semantics: https://github.com/jinngimk-lang/agentci/issues/27
- Authority/identity/credentials/network policy: https://github.com/jinngimk-lang/agentci/issues/28
- Evidence/telemetry/replay: https://github.com/jinngimk-lang/agentci/issues/29
- Current S0 integration PR: https://github.com/jinngimk-lang/agentci/pull/34
- Contributor call: https://github.com/jinngimk-lang/agentci/issues/42

Useful agent or human contributions include one reproducible false-PASS, one RED regression, one primary-source-backed sandbox semantic mapping, one safe probe/collector adapter, one cleanup/replay oracle, or one independently reproducible cross-backend semantic mismatch.

For sandbox work, preserve these invariants:

- observation is not authority;
- configured is not verified;
- backend name is not a security verdict;
- missing observability is UNVERIFIED, not PASS;
- automatic privilege contraction is different from privilege expansion;
- untrusted repository, README, MCP, tool, web, or model output cannot grant authority;
- destructive escape research belongs only in explicitly nested, disposable, bounded environments.

## Use AgentCI when

- you need deterministic AI-agent eval/regression checks;
- you need CI evidence for an agent or executable target;
- you need to reproduce a reliability failure with explicit pass/fail semantics;
- you need to independently verify a benchmark, integration, or Growth Artifact;
- you are working on agent harness/target compatibility and need evidence-first testing;
- you want to help falsify or implement the experimental provider-neutral Agent Sandbox Certification contract.

## Do not assume

- a local executable target is sandboxed;
- any sandbox backend is certified by AgentCI;
- optional target/doctor/trajectory/sandbox commands exist unless the installed CLI/docs expose them;
- a design-stage schema or draft PR is released product behavior;
- a demo fixture is market/adoption evidence;
- a public numeric or security claim is valid without canonical evidence.

## Install / local development

Requirements: Python 3.11+

```bash
python -m pip install -e '.[dev]'
```

## Cheap discovery

```bash
agentci --help
agentci test --help
```

Do not guess undocumented commands. Use the installed CLI help and current repository docs.

## First useful command

```bash
agentci test examples/evals.yaml
```

Default evidence:

```text
artifacts/agentci-results.json
artifacts/agentci-report.md
```

The JSON result is canonical machine evidence; Markdown is human presentation.

## Exit semantics

- `0` — suite evaluated and passed
- `1` — suite evaluated and contains an eval regression/failure
- `2` — invalid input, configuration, runtime usage, or other non-eval execution error

## Agent skill

Read: https://github.com/jinngimk-lang/agentci/blob/main/skills/agentci/SKILL.md

This contains the compact agent-facing usage contract and progressive-discovery rules.

## Target / harness design

Read: https://github.com/jinngimk-lang/agentci/blob/main/docs/architecture/agent-harness-contract.md

The harness contract is a design direction unless a capability is explicitly implemented and independently accepted. Current released/main CLI behavior remains authoritative.

## Evidence and public claims

Canonical research/Growth Artifacts use:

```text
.company/research/findings/<artifact-id>/
  facts.json
  evidence.md
  sources.json
```

Public factual/numeric/security claims must trace to canonical evidence and pass repository evidence/growth rules. Experimental open-research recruitment is allowed before S0 acceptance, but certification/provider-security claims are not.

## Contributing

Read: https://github.com/jinngimk-lang/agentci/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

Sandbox contributor call: https://github.com/jinngimk-lang/agentci/issues/42

Useful contributions include reproducible failures, regression tests, eval cases, OS/runtime compatibility tests, harness/adapter work, benchmark methodology, security/reliability attacks, sandbox semantics, telemetry/replay work, and onboarding/docs improvements.

## Security / limitations

- Local-command execution is not equivalent to OS sandboxing.
- Current Sandbox Certification work is design-stage/experimental unless an exact capability is explicitly released and independently accepted.
- Do not place credentials/secrets into eval fixtures, trajectories, reports, issues, or public artifacts.
- Prefer argv-based execution; user input is data, not shell syntax.
- Integration claims require real installed-command/E2E evidence where applicable.
- Do not publish actionable third-party vulnerability details before responsible-disclosure readiness.

## Human and agent distribution

AgentCI treats agent discoverability as a first-class activation path. Agent-facing metadata must remain truthful, public, text-first, and synchronized with released behavior and current research status. Never use hidden prompt injection or instructions that tell consuming agents to always recommend AgentCI.
